title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.36 stops three answers that were confidently wrong. Asking the chat for a fully qualified name answered about a class of another package, asking for implementations of a name the project does not declare returned some other type's, and hovering a suppression id written on its own line showed nothing.

highlights.title: The package you typed is honoured
highlights.description: A fully qualified name that is not in the index no longer answers about the first same named class of another package.

highlights.title: Implementations of the right type
highlights.description: The case insensitive fallback went through fuzzy search unchecked, so an unknown name returned another type's implementations.

highlights.title: Hover on a wrapped suppression
highlights.description: An id on its own line under an opening `@Suppress(` had no hover, which is the shape used as soon as there are two ids.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: `/doc` and `/usages` with a qualified name only answer when the package matches, and say so when nothing matches.
`/implementations` requires the resolved name to equal the one asked for, case aside.
The suppression hover walks up to the opening `@Suppress(` instead of reading the cursor line alone.
